$comment: Brand-and-claim rules for luvita.tr (luvita-docs#9, EmirErs W7). Run after `npm run build`: python3 .github/scripts/brand-check.py. Schema: https://github.com/AnunnakiCosmoCrew/project-templates/tree/main/actions/brand-claim-check

rules.why: adr/0005: https://luvita.tr/ is a real identity page, never a redirect; the previous stub cost a credit-programme round.

rules.pattern: Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
rules.why: adr/0005: the root identity card carries the registered trade name in the HTML the server sends.
adr/0005: the root page carries the MERSİS number for a verifier running curl (LUVITA.md, Legal entity).
adr/0005: the root page carries contact@luvita.tr in server-sent HTML.

rules.pattern: <script type="application/ld\+json">\{[^<]*"legalName":"Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi"
rules.why: adr/0005: Organization JSON-LD ships from BaseHead on every page because we do not choose where a verifier lands. The two retired-route stubs (LW-12 redirects) are excluded.
CLAUDE.md / adr/0006: never set redirectToDefaultLocale: true again; Astro would generate the root itself and ignore the identity page.
LUVITA.md, Legal entity: the registered office is the founder's home; the street address is never published on our own surfaces (rule inventory 54/118).
CLAUDE.md (LW-17): no company address in rendered page text, not even the city; LOCATION survives only in the JSON-LD address block. Matches text nodes only.

LUVITA.md: luvita.tr shows no city at all (LW-17). The root page's description / og:description / twitter:description still say "Bodrum, Muğla"; reported as a warning until the founder decides (luvita-docs#9).

rules.pattern: Luvita Teknoloji Enerji|Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım|LUVİTA TEKNOLOJİ ENERJİ
allow: Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
rules.why: CLAUDE.md / adr/0003 (amended by adr/0005): the full trade name is legal identity, never copy; only the exact registered form, in the footer legal block, the root identity block and JSON-LD legalName.
CLAUDE.md: the trade name must never appear in a <meta name="description">, the snippet a search result shows (rule inventory 56).
adr/0003: the consumer solar brand never appears on luvita.tr; the vitrines stay separate (LUVITA.md, Brands).
adr/0003: no GES/solar content in the site body; the guard the ADR asked for (`GES|güneş|solar` outside the legal constants).
CLAUDE.md / adr/0006: zero client-side JS; the root page's inline locale redirect is the single sanctioned exception, a <script> on any other page is a regression.
CLAUDE.md: no external requests; the root redirect is inline and loads no library.
CLAUDE.md: no analytics, no fonts, no CDN embeds; the privacy pages promise no cookies and no tracking.
LUVITA.md, Brands: LexiPower never "WordPower", Umay never "Yaren" in public (rule inventory 58).
adr/0004: product company only; the Services page was retired (LW-12) and nothing may link to it again.
